long: Shadow of the Colossus is a 2005 action-adventure game for the PlayStation 2. The player journeys across a vast, desolate land to slay sixteen towering colossi in order to revive a lost loved one. Each colossus is a moving puzzle-boss that must be scaled and struck at its weak points, with minimal combat in between.
name: Shadow of the Colossus
